Reon Energy usually refers to Reon Energy Limited, a Pakistan‑based clean‑energy company. It designs, builds, finances, and operates solar PV and hybrid power systems for commercial and industrial customers.

What they do:
- Industrial/commercial solar (rooftop, ground‑mount, carport)
- Battery energy storage and hybrid microgrids (solar + batteries + grid/generators)
- O&M and remote performance monitoring
- Financing options (CAPEX or power‑purchase agreements)

Background:
- Part of Dawood Lawrencepur Limited (Dawood Group)
- Headquartered in Karachi; projects primarily across Pakistan

If you meant a different “Reon Energy” (in another country or a similarly named startup), share a link and I’ll tailor the info.
